kalfou-transportation-ecosystem.title: Kalfou
kalfou-transportation-ecosystem.description: Comprehensive transportation platform with ride-hailing, package delivery, and food delivery services. Built with microservices architecture featuring 1 API, 3 mobile apps, and 3 web applications.

vision.label: Project vision
vision.heading: One platform. Three services.
vision.text: Kalfou is an ambitious, full-scale transportation and delivery ecosystem designed to serve multiple user segments through a unified platform. The system integrates **ride-hailing**, **package delivery**, and **food delivery** into a cohesive, scalable solution.

architecture.label: System Architecture
architecture.heading: Microservices Backend
architecture.text: The Central Web API (ASP.NET Core) acts as the unified gateway for all client applications. Services are separated by domain — User Management, Ride Service, Delivery Service, and Payment Service — communicating asynchronously via Azure Service Bus.

list.0: Unified RESTful API serving all client applications
list.3: Rate limiting and API gateway pattern
list.4: Redis caching for sessions and hot data

mobile.label: Mobile Applications
mobile.heading: Flutter apps for every role
mobile.text: Three distinct Flutter apps share a common design system and authentication layer, each tailored to a specific user role.

list.0: **Customer App** — Request rides, order food, send packages, in-app chat, ratings
list.1: **Driver App** — Accept trips, real-time navigation, earnings dashboard, offline mode
list.2: **Delivery App** — Accept deliveries, route optimization, proof of delivery (photo/signature)

img.caption: Customer, Driver, and Delivery mobile interfaces

list.0: **Customer Web Portal** — Desktop-optimized version of the mobile app with advanced search and booking management
list.1: **Restaurant Dashboard** — Menu management, real-time order tracking, analytics and promotions
list.2: **Admin Dashboard** — Full platform monitoring, user management, fraud detection, and financial reporting

stack.label: Technical Stack
stack.heading: Built to scale
stack.text: The infrastructure runs on **Azure** with Docker containers orchestrated by Kubernetes, enabling horizontal scaling across all services. CI/CD is handled by Azure DevOps with automated testing at every stage.

callout.title: Database Design
callout.content: 30+ normalized tables with geospatial indexing for real-time location queries. Partitioning strategy handles high-frequency ride and delivery events at scale.

mrlabelling-3d-reconstruction-hololens.title: MrLabelling
mrlabelling-3d-reconstruction-hololens.description: Research platform for automatic 3D object segmentation and reconstruction from HoloLens 2 data. Combines YOLO, Mask R-CNN, and SAM achieving 80% precision for mixed reality applications.

overview.label: Overview
overview.heading: 3D Reconstruction for Mixed Reality
overview.text: MrLabelling is a research project developed as part of my Master's thesis at UQAC. The platform automates 3D object segmentation and reconstruction from Microsoft HoloLens 2 sensor data, serving both smart environment MR applications and high-quality ML dataset creation.

list.0: **YOLO** — Fast object detection, real-time performance, bounding box generation
list.1: **Mask R-CNN** — Pixel-perfect instance segmentation, multi-class detection
list.2: **SAM (Segment Anything)** — Zero-shot segmentation, interactive point-and-click annotation

list.0: **Capture** — HoloLens 2 spatial scanning with RGB-D sensor fusion
list.1: **Segmentation** — AI model object detection and masking
list.2: **Annotation** — Manual refinement if needed via the annotation platform

callout.title: Published Research
callout.content: Co-authored paper: Automatic 3D Object Segmentation and Reconstruction from HoloLens 2 Data for Mixed Reality in Smart Environments — submitted to UCAml 2025, 17th International Conference on Ubiquitous Computing and Ambient Intelligence. Published in Springer Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems.

tiamshop-ecommerce-platform.title: Tiamshop
tiamshop-ecommerce-platform.description: Full-stack e-commerce platform for electronics sales with ASP.NET Core backend and React frontend. Best capstone project award (18.5/20).

overview.label: Overview
overview.heading: E-commerce built for Niger
overview.text: Tiamshop is a full-stack e-commerce platform specialising in electronics, developed as my Bachelor's capstone project. It addresses the growing demand for trusted online shopping in Niger — awarded **Best Capstone Project (18.5/20)**.

list.0: **Customer** — Browse 70+ products, advanced filtering, persistent cart, real-time order tracking
list.1: **Admin** — Full product CRUD, order validation, inventory control, sector-based delivery assignment, sales analytics
list.2: **Delivery** — View assigned deliveries by zone, mark as in-progress or completed

callout.title: Tech Stack
callout.content: Backend: ASP.NET Core Web API with JWT auth, SQL Server + Entity Framework Core + Dapper, Mailgun transactional emails. Frontend: React + TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS + Material-UI. Deployed on Azure App Service + Netlify via GitHub Actions CI/CD.

personal-portfolio-website.title: Personal Portfolio
personal-portfolio-website.description: Modern, high-performance portfolio built with Next.js 15, featuring advanced animations, dark/light themes, and full English/French internationalization.

overview.label: Overview
overview.heading: This very website
overview.text: A modern, meticulously crafted portfolio built with **Next.js 15 App Router** — React Server Components, SSR + SSG, full English/French internationalisation via next-intl, and seamless dark/light theming.

list.0: Next.js 15 App Router with React Server Components
list.1: Full i18n with next-intl (EN/FR) and locale-aware routing
list.2: Framer Motion page transitions and scroll-triggered reveals
list.3: Dark/light mode with CSS variables and system preference detection
list.4: Strict TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, conventional commits

thoraxvision-pulmonary-disease-detection.title: ThoraxVision
thoraxvision-pulmonary-disease-detection.description: AI-powered web application for detecting pulmonary diseases from chest X-rays using deep learning. YOLO-based detection with 80% accuracy on the NIH dataset.

overview.label: Overview
overview.heading: AI-assisted pulmonary diagnosis
overview.text: ThoraxVision is a deep learning application that assists medical professionals in diagnosing pulmonary diseases from chest X-ray images, combining computer vision with an intuitive clinical web interface.

list.0: YOLO-based multi-disease detection (pneumonia, tuberculosis, and more)
list.1: Patient data integration for comprehensive diagnosis context
list.2: Flask RESTful API for integration with existing medical systems

callout.title: Clinical Value
callout.content: Reduces diagnosis time from hours to seconds. Designed for both standalone local deployment and integration into third-party medical systems via the open-source REST API.
